description: For a finite atom set \(P\), the Boolean algebra of formula classes has \(2^{2^{|P|}}\) elements, including when \(P\) is empty.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.finite_algebra_card.{u} {α : Type u} [Fintype α] :
  Nat.card (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.FormulaAlgebra α) = 2 ^ 2 ^ Fintype.card α
